description_full:
Nyari magang GA & IT di Karawaci? Say less! 🚀

PT Gumindo Bogamanis is hiring General Affair & IT Intern!
What you'll do: Bantu operasional/administrasi GA harian, maintenance fasilitas, plus ngasih tech support (hardware/software/jaringan) buat karyawan.
Who we need: Mahasiswa (min. smt 5) atau fresh grad dari IT/SI/Manajemen/Bisnis. Wajib jago MS Office & administrasi. Ngerti basic networking? Huge plus!

Drop CV ke richard.willem@gumindo.com cc hr@gumindo.com (Subject: GA & IT INTERN_NAMA).
